spans.s: --the magic car of iron obtained by tapas from शिव by शाल्व; made by Maya fitted with all illusory powers. भा. X. ७६. 1, 3-7; ७८. १३.
--a son of बृहत्श्लोक and the grandson of वामन. भा. VI. १८. 7-8.

(I)--a ऋग् Vedic sage who got himself trans- formed into a youthful person and requested king मान्- धात्रि for his daughter's hand; when he was asked to select one from the harem, he went in, when all his fifty daughters wanted to have him as their husband. So he agreed; after enjoying worldly pleasure for long, he felt the urge for मुक्ति and retired to the forest, with his wives following and became a वैखानसभिक्षु; lived with them; father of १५० sons; when the sage was dead, all his wives burnt themselves on his funeral pyre;
1: भा.

. ६९ to end.
before his marriage he was engaged in penance. Once immersed under the waters of the यमुना in contemplation of the Lord, he saw a fish in sexual union and felt a desire for home life; on another occasion he noticed गरुड consuming a fish, and cursed on behalf of [page३-704+ ३०] the sages that गरुड's visit to कालिन्दि would be his death.

(III)--a son of सत्या and कृष्ण. Br. III. ७१. २४७.

--when प्रलय went up to the mahar- lokam and when the whole world was overwhelmed by अहङ्कार there was a dispute between ब्रह्मा and कृष्ण when out of the latter's chest a light in the shape of a Linga came out. It was drunk by दक्ष son of ब्रह्मा and the result was the birth of सती. The rest of रस became eight- fold, seven substances bringing fortune and salt. M. ६०. 6-१०.

--in honour of उमा; to be begun on Vasanta शुक्ल triti1ya1 and continued for a year every त्रितीया when सती married शिव; after purificatory baths, offer prayers to उमा and also to शिव in the midst of the eight सौभाग्यस् by flowers, incense, etc.; at the end a gift of a bed is prescribed; the performer gets desired things and ultimately reaches heaven; he who does it for १२ years, or 7 or 8 lives a happy long life. Madana, Sata- dhanva, कार्तवीर्य, वरुण and Nandi have done this. M. ६०. 1. ४६. [page३-705+ २५]
--sugar cane, रसराज, निष्पाव, जाजि, धान्यकम्, गोक्षीरम्, kurumbham and salt. M. ६०. 7-8, २८.
